adjudication.rationale: In `Admin::EmbeddableHostsController#destroy`, the code calls `host.destroy` and then unconditionally `render json: success_json` without checking whether the record was actually destroyed (`host.destroyed?`) or handling a failed destroy. If a `before_destroy` callback aborts the destroy, the action would still report success. (FK violations would likely raise and prevent rendering, but callback-aborted destroys would not.)
